text:
sam: okay important cultural initiative: lunchtime shanty contest. theme: spreadsheets. yes this is happening. :sailboat: :bar_chart:

izzy: do we sing about pivot tables or the sorrow of lost formulas? both are valid verses. :microphone:

marcus: chorus idea: 'Oh the rows they keep on rolling, and the cells they never end' 

anya: i'm in if prizes include a sticker pack and one tiny crown for the winner. small incentives, huge morale.

joel: can we have live accompaniment? i can bring my tiny travel ukulele. also kazoo backup approved. :ukulele: :kazoo:

izzy: rough draft verse, feel free to steal/mangle:
```
We sailed at dawn on a sea of CSV,
Filters torn wide by a rogue downstream key.
Sum and mean like the thunder roll,
Oh guard your VLOOKUP, poor weary soul.
```

sam: PERFECT. label that verse V1. we'll iterate at lunch. :sparkles:

kb-bot: poll created — 'Spreadsheet Shanty: Will you perform?' Options: Yes / Maybe / Only clap along

marcus: voted Maybe (i will clap and accidentally start a hand percussion break)

joel: voted Yes. bringing uke and a kazoo. someone remind me to tune it though.

anya: voted Only clap along. also volunteered to make tiny crowns from leftover conference swag.

izzy: side quest: can we get someone to craft a dramatic wave sound effect? i'm thinking crinkled bubble wrap + a tub. theatrical is important. :ocean:

sam: logistics: noon, Friday by the big whiteboard. 3 minute max per act. open signups on the sheet pinned to the fridge.

marcus: can we make a ritual handshake after the winners? i propose the 'cell-lock' where you twist an imaginary dial and snap. lore potential is high.

joel: adding sheet to fridge now. also adding a column for 'shanty difficulty' (1-5 storms).

izzy: title contenders so far: 'The Ballad of Broken Formulas', 'Ode to the Hidden Column', 'When Pivoted Weep'

sam: this thread now the canonical home for lyrics and props. bring your best nautical-sans-sans-serif vibes. :sailboat: :crown:
